claim: Menu prices go through parsers/menu-price.ts, which gives an amount only for a string with one reading (`1.250`: none, two_readings); the CSV/XLSX reader and reviewMenuItem use it, the CSV reader sniffs comma/semicolon/tab, and .xls is refused in words. Specs: menu-price, csv-parser.service, menus.service (gap M3).
verify: d=apps/api-gateway/src/menus; test -f $d/parsers/menu-price.ts && grep -q 'return none(raw, "two_readings")' $d/parsers/menu-price.ts && grep -q 'readMenuPrice(raw)' $d/parsers/csv-parser.service.ts && grep -q 'readMenuPrice(dto.newValue)' $d/menus.service.ts && ! grep -qF '[^0-9.]' $d/parsers/csv-parser.service.ts && ! grep -qF '[^0-9.]' $d/menus.service.ts && grep -q 'older Excel file (.xls)' $d/parsers/csv-parser.service.ts && grep -q 'const DELIMITERS = \[",", ";", "\\t"\]' $d/parsers/csv-parser.service.ts
